snippet.title: Bonereader — Teaser
snippet.description:
A card-based deckbuilder with dice mechanics. Executed in an electric chair, you awaken in a shamanic, mescaline-fueled Purgatory inspired by Castaneda and McCarthy, where you battle spirits in games of chance for a shot at rebirth.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4240080/Bonereader/

Dear friends, it finally happened! Bonereader now has its own Steam page! ⚡💀

Bonereader is a card game with dice mechanics. You’re executed in the electric chair — and wake up in a shamanic Purgatory, where you must defeat strange spirits in games of chance for the right to be reborn.

Please consider adding the game to your wishlist and sharing it with friends — it helps us a lot!

The demo launches on April 21. 🎲
